description: The chart illustrates the proportional breakdown of two metrics for two different models across four distinct domains, presented as a series of four side-by-side subplots. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variables, displaying the models "70B llama" and "8B llama" rotated diagonally within each of the four panels, which are titled "Health and Nutrition," "Logistics," an obscured title covered by a solid grey rectangle, and "Travel and Transportation." The vertical axis, located only on the far-left edge of the figure, represents the value on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2, though neither axis has an explicit overall title. The data is visualized using 100% stacked bars, where each bar reaches a total height of 1.0. According to the legend at the bottom, the bottom segment of each bar is colored teal and represents "MVS," while the top segment is colored light blue and represents "1-MVS." The teal "MVS" segments vary across the categories; the tallest teal segment is found in the 70B llama bar of the third (obscured) panel at approximately 0.72, while the shortest teal segment is in the 8B llama bar of the same panel at approximately 0.36. In the "Health and Nutrition" panel, the MVS values are roughly 0.59 for 70B llama and 0.39 for 8B llama; in "Logistics," they are about 0.51 and 0.48, respectively; and in "Travel and Transportation," they are approximately 0.39 and 0.37. The light blue "1-MVS" segments make up the remainder of each bar, inversely ranging from approximately 0.28 to 0.64. The bars are consistently ordered with 70B llama preceding 8B llama in every panel, and aside from the grey rectangle obscuring the third panel's title, no specific bars are visually emphasized or sorted by value.
